title: EnvironmentFile
description: One environment, one JSON file under environments/ inside a collection folder. An environment answers BOTH "where" and "how to get there" (design §6.5): baseUrl-style values and the route are one record, so a production request cannot accidentally go out around the bastion — the address and the route cannot drift apart because they are not two facts. It holds plain values, the NAMES of its secret variables, and the route; it holds no secret values and no identifiers for them. This is a PERSISTED format; see contracts/files/README.md.

values.description: Plain, non-secret values by variable name.

secretVars.description: The NAMES of the variables whose values are secret, and nothing else — not the values, and not identifiers for them. An unresolved one BLOCKS the send and names itself: not the literal {{braces}} sent to the server, and not an empty string quietly substituted, which is worse than the failure it hides (design §6.5).

profileId.description: The saved connection a "connection" route goes through. A profile id, never a credential.
